panels.description: "Last 1 month" = date of today - same date last month. Eg: 10th July to 10th Aug

targets.original_sql:
WITH DailyTrackCounts AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN song_name = 'Never Giving Up'
      OR song_name = 'Never Giving Up Again' THEN 'Never Giving Up/Again'
      ELSE song_name
    END AS unified_song_name,
    DATE(created_at) AS created_at,
    play_count,
    COUNT(*) as frequency
  FROM
    tracks
  WHERE
    artist ILIKE '%' || '${artist_name}' || '%'
  GROUP BY
    CASE
      WHEN song_name = 'Never Giving Up'
      OR song_name = 'Never Giving Up Again' THEN 'Never Giving Up/Again'
      ELSE song_name
    END,
    DATE(created_at),
    play_count
),
ModePlayCountPerDay AS (
  SELECT
    unified_song_name AS song_name,
    created_at,
    play_count AS mode_play_count
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        unified_song_name,
        created_at,
        play_count,
        frequency,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
          PARTITION BY unified_song_name,
          created_at
          ORDER BY
            frequency DESC,
            play_count DESC
        ) as rnum
      FROM
        DailyTrackCounts
    ) AS sq
  WHERE
    rnum = 1
),
daily_change AS (
  SELECT
    song_name,
    created_at,
    mode_play_count - LAG(mode_play_count, 1, 0) OVER (
      PARTITION BY song_name
      ORDER BY
        created_at
    ) AS daily_streams_change
  FROM
    ModePlayCountPerDay
),
period_ordering AS (
  SELECT
    'Last 24 hours' AS period,
    SUM(daily_streams_change) AS total_streams,
    1 as order_idx
  FROM
    daily_change
  WHERE
    created_at = CURRENT_DATE
  UNION
  ALL
  SELECT
    'Last 7 days' AS period,
    SUM(daily_streams_change),
    2 as order_idx
  FROM
    daily_change
  WHERE
    created_at BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days'
    AND CURRENT_DATE
  UNION
  ALL
  SELECT
    'Last 28 days' AS period,
    SUM(daily_streams_change),
    3 as order_idx
  FROM
    daily_change
  WHERE
    created_at BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '27 days'
    AND CURRENT_DATE
  UNION
  ALL
  SELECT
    'Last 30 days' AS period,
    SUM(daily_streams_change),
    4 as order_idx
  FROM
    daily_change
  WHERE
    created_at BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '29 days'
    AND CURRENT_DATE
  UNION
  ALL
  SELECT
    'Last 1 month' AS period,
    SUM(daily_streams_change),
    5 as order_idx
  FROM
    daily_change
  WHERE
    created_at BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month'
    AND CURRENT_DATE
  UNION
  ALL
  SELECT
    'Since 1st Feb 2024' AS period,
    SUM(daily_streams_change),
    6 as order_idx
  FROM
    daily_change
  WHERE
    created_at >= DATE '2024-02-03'
  UNION
  ALL
  SELECT
    'Peak Daily Streams' AS period,
    MAX(total_daily_change) AS total_streams,
    7 as order_idx
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        created_at,
        SUM(daily_streams_change) AS total_daily_change
      FROM
        daily_change
      GROUP BY
        created_at
    ) aggregated_daily_change
  WHERE
    created_at > (
      SELECT
        MIN(created_at)
      FROM
        daily_change
    )
  UNION
  ALL
  SELECT
    'Only Apr 2024' AS period,
    SUM(daily_streams_change),
    8 as order_idx
  FROM
    daily_change
  WHERE
    created_at BETWEEN DATE '2023-04-03'
    AND DATE '2024-05-02'
  UNION
  ALL
  SELECT
    'Only May 2024' AS period,
    SUM(daily_streams_change),
    9 as order_idx
  FROM
    daily_change
  WHERE
    created_at BETWEEN DATE '2024-05-03'
    AND DATE '2024-06-02'
)
SELECT
  period,
  total_streams
FROM
  period_ordering
ORDER BY
  order_idx,
  period DESC;

quirks: Daily change = difference to the previous ROW (LAG), not the previous calendar day: a multi-day collection gap is attributed to a single day.
First observation of a track (or a track whose previous calendar day is missing) gets daily change = its whole cumulative count (default 0 for the missing previous day).
Artist match is a case-insensitive SUBSTRING match: the selected artist also matches every artist string that contains the text (collabs, longer names); '%'/'_' in names act as wildcards.
Hard-coded merge of the two song names 'Never Giving Up' and 'Never Giving Up Again'.
Hard-coded calendar dates in the SQL.
Relative time (NOW()/CURRENT_DATE): evaluated at the dataset anchor (last observation), Grafana evaluated it at view time.

panels.title: Total Streams: ${artist_name}

targets.original_sql:
WITH DailyTrackCounts AS (
    -- Count how many times each play_count occurs per song per day where the selected artist is one of the artists
    SELECT
        song_name,
        DATE(created_at) AS created_at,
        play_count,
        COUNT(*) as frequency
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        artist ILIKE '%' || '${artist_name}' || '%'
    GROUP BY
        song_name, DATE(created_at), play_count
),

ModePlayCountPerDay AS (
    -- Find the play_count with the highest frequency per song per day (mode)
    SELECT
        song_name,
        created_at,
        play_count AS mode_play_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            song_name,
            created_at,
            play_count,
            frequency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY song_name, created_at ORDER BY frequency DESC, play_count DESC) as rnum
        FROM
            DailyTrackCounts
    ) AS sq
    WHERE
        rnum = 1
),

daily_totals AS (
    SELECT
        created_at AS date,
        SUM(mode_play_count) AS total_streams
    FROM
        ModePlayCountPerDay
    GROUP BY
        created_at
)

SELECT
  date,
  total_streams
FROM
  daily_totals
ORDER BY
  date;

WITH DailyTrackCounts AS (
    -- Count how many times each play_count occurs per song per day where the selected artist is one of the artists
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN song_name = 'Never Giving Up' OR song_name = 'Never Giving Up Again' THEN 'Never Giving Up/Again' 
            ELSE song_name 
        END AS song_name,
        DATE(created_at) AS created_at,
        play_count,
        COUNT(*) as frequency
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        artist ILIKE '%' || '${artist_name}' || '%'
    GROUP BY
        CASE 
            WHEN song_name = 'Never Giving Up' OR song_name = 'Never Giving Up Again' THEN 'Never Giving Up/Again' 
            ELSE song_name 
        END, DATE(created_at), play_count
),

ModePlayCountPerDay AS (
    -- Find the play_count with the highest frequency per song per day (mode)
    SELECT
        song_name,
        created_at,
        play_count AS mode_play_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            song_name,
            created_at,
            play_count,
            frequency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY song_name, created_at ORDER BY frequency DESC, play_count DESC) as rnum
        FROM
            DailyTrackCounts
    ) AS sq
    WHERE
        rnum = 1
),

daily_change_per_song AS (
    SELECT
        song_name,
        created_at,
        mode_play_count - LAG(mode_play_count, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY song_name ORDER BY created_at) AS daily_streams_change
    FROM
        ModePlayCountPerDay
),

AggregatedDailyChange AS (
    -- Sum up the daily changes for all songs
    SELECT
        created_at AS date,
        SUM(daily_streams_change) AS daily_change_in_streams
    FROM
        daily_change_per_song
    WHERE
        created_at > (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM daily_change_per_song)
    GROUP BY
        created_at
)

SELECT
    date,
    daily_change_in_streams,
    AVG(daily_change_in_streams) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7_days
FROM
    AggregatedDailyChange
ORDER BY
    date;

panels.description: "Last 1 month" = date of today - same date last month. Eg: 10th July to 10th Aug

targets.original_sql:
WITH DailyTrackCounts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(created_at) AS created_at,
        play_count,
        COUNT(*) as frequency
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        position('${artist_name}' in artist) > 0 AND 
        (song_name = '${track_name}' OR 
         song_name = CASE 
                        WHEN '${track_name}' = 'Never Giving Up' THEN 'Never Giving Up Again' 
                        WHEN '${track_name}' = 'Never Giving Up Again' THEN 'Never Giving Up' 
                        ELSE '${track_name}' 
                     END)
    GROUP BY
        DATE(created_at), play_count
),

ModePlayCountPerDay AS (
    SELECT
        created_at,
        play_count AS mode_play_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            created_at,
            play_count,
            frequency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY created_at ORDER BY frequency DESC, play_count DESC) as rnum
        FROM
            DailyTrackCounts
    ) AS sq
    WHERE
        rnum = 1
),

daily_change AS (
    SELECT
        created_at,
        mode_play_count - LAG(mode_play_count, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY created_at) AS daily_streams_change
    FROM
        ModePlayCountPerDay
)

, period_ordering AS (
    SELECT 
        'Last 24 hours' AS period,
        SUM(daily_streams_change) AS total_streams,
        1 as order_idx
    FROM daily_change
    WHERE 
        created_at = CURRENT_DATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'Last 7 days' AS period,
        SUM(daily_streams_change),
        2 as order_idx
    FROM 
        daily_change
    WHERE
        created_at BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days' AND CURRENT_DATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'Last 28 days' AS period,
        SUM(daily_streams_change),
        3 as order_idx
    FROM 
        daily_change
    WHERE
        created_at BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '27 days' AND CURRENT_DATE
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'Last 30 days' AS period,
        SUM(daily_streams_change),
        4 as order_idx
    FROM 
        daily_change
    WHERE
        created_at BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '29 days' AND CURRENT_DATE
    UNION ALL

targets.original_sql:
WITH HourlyTotalCounts AS (
    -- Calculate the total play_count for each playlist for each hour
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS hour,
        playlist_id,
        SUM(play_count) AS hourly_total_count
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        playlist_id IN ('0OwqBeZIh0JNJcIVobdtOz', '6Cbnl3B3t8mPcEXWskPjfw')
    GROUP BY
        hour, playlist_id
),
Frequencies AS (
    -- Calculate frequency of each hourly total play count for each playlist for each day
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', hour) AS day,
        playlist_id,
        hourly_total_count,
        COUNT(*) AS freq
    FROM
        HourlyTotalCounts
    GROUP BY
        day, playlist_id, hourly_total_count
),
MaxFreq AS (
    -- For each day, find the max frequency for hourly total play count for each playlist
    SELECT
        day,
        playlist_id,
        hourly_total_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            day,
            playlist_id,
            hourly_total_count,
            freq,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY day, playlist_id ORDER BY freq DESC, hourly_total_count DESC) as rnum
        FROM
            Frequencies
    ) AS sq
    WHERE
        rnum = 1
)
-- Sum up the modes of both playlists to get a combined total for each day
SELECT
    day AS "time",
    SUM(hourly_total_count) AS "total_stream_count"
FROM
    MaxFreq
GROUP BY
    day
ORDER BY
    day;

WITH RankedMilestones AS (
    SELECT 
        artist || ' - ' || 
        CASE 
            WHEN song_name = 'Never Giving Up' OR song_name = 'Never Giving Up Again' THEN 'Never Giving Up Again' 
            ELSE song_name 
        END AS "Artist - Track", 
        play_count, 
        milestone, 
        created_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 
            CASE 
                WHEN song_name = 'Never Giving Up' OR song_name = 'Never Giving Up Again' THEN 'Never Giving Up Again' 
                ELSE song_name 
            END, artist ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rnk
    FROM 
        milestones 
    WHERE 
        created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 days'
)

SELECT 
    "Artist - Track",
    play_count, 
    milestone, 
    created_at 
FROM 
    RankedMilestones
WHERE 
    rnk = 1
ORDER BY 
    created_at DESC 
LIMIT 
    100;

WITH DailyTrackCounts AS (
    -- Count how many times each play_count occurs for the track per day
    SELECT
        DATE(created_at) AS created_at,
        song_name,
        artist,
        play_count,
        COUNT(*) as frequency
    FROM
        tracks
    GROUP BY
        DATE(created_at), song_name, artist, play_count
),

ModePlayCountPerDay AS (
    -- Find the play_count with the highest frequency for the track per day (mode)
    SELECT
        created_at,
        song_name,
        artist,
        play_count AS mode_play_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            created_at,
            song_name,
            artist,
            play_count,
            frequency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY created_at, song_name, artist ORDER BY frequency DESC, play_count DESC) as rnum
        FROM
            DailyTrackCounts
    ) AS sq
    WHERE
        rnum = 1
)

, daily_change AS (
    SELECT
        t1.song_name,
        t1.artist,
        t1.created_at AS date,
        t1.mode_play_count - COALESCE(t2.mode_play_count, 0) AS daily_streams_change
    FROM
        ModePlayCountPerDay t1
    LEFT JOIN
        ModePlayCountPerDay t2
    ON
        t1.song_name = t2.song_name
        AND t1.artist = t2.artist
        AND t1.created_at = t2.created_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
)

  AND NOT (t1.artist = 'JMRA, Scarlett, Jr Stit' AND t1.song_name = 'So Long Ago - Remix')

LIMIT 100;

targets.original_sql:
WITH HourlyTotalCounts AS (
    -- Calculate the total play_count for each playlist for each hour
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS hour,
        playlist_id,
        SUM(play_count) AS hourly_total_count
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        playlist_id IN ('0OwqBeZIh0JNJcIVobdtOz', '6Cbnl3B3t8mPcEXWskPjfw')
    GROUP BY
        hour, playlist_id
),
Frequencies AS (
    -- Calculate frequency of each hourly total play count for each playlist for each day
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', hour) AS day,
        playlist_id,
        hourly_total_count,
        COUNT(*) AS freq
    FROM
        HourlyTotalCounts
    GROUP BY
        day, playlist_id, hourly_total_count
),
MaxFreq AS (
    -- For each day, find the max frequency for hourly total play count for each playlist
    SELECT
        day,
        playlist_id,
        hourly_total_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            day,
            playlist_id,
            hourly_total_count,
            freq,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY day, playlist_id ORDER BY freq DESC, hourly_total_count DESC) as rnum
        FROM
            Frequencies
    ) AS sq
    WHERE
        rnum = 1
),
CombinedCounts AS (
    -- Sum up the modes of both playlists to get a combined total for each day
    SELECT
        day,
        SUM(hourly_total_count) AS total_stream_count
    FROM
        MaxFreq
    GROUP BY
        day
)
-- Compute the monthly change by comparing the stream count of the 2nd of each month
SELECT
    day AS "time",
    total_stream_count - COALESCE(LAG(total_stream_count) OVER (ORDER BY day), 0) AS "monthly_change"
FROM
    CombinedCounts
WHERE
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM day) = 2
ORDER BY
    day;

    select
        day,
        playlist_id,
        hourly_total_count
    from (
        select
            day,
            playlist_id,
            hourly_total_count,
            freq,
            row_number() over(partition by day, playlist_id order by freq desc, hourly_total_count desc) as rnum
        from
            frequencies
    ) as sq
    where
        rnum = 1
),
combinedcounts as (
    -- Sum up the modes of both playlists to get a combined total for each day
    select
        day,
        sum(hourly_total_count) as total_stream_count
    from
        maxfreq
    group by
        day
)
-- Compute the monthly change by comparing the stream count of the 2nd of each month

    day as "time",
    total_stream_count - coalesce(lag(total_stream_count) over (order by day), 0) as "monthly_change"
from
    combinedcounts

    extract(day from day) = 2

WITH LatestPlayCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        song_name,
        artist,
        MAX(play_count) AS latest_play_count
    FROM 
        tracks
    WHERE
        artist NOT IN (
            'Revelries', 'Lone Tusker', 'Offmind', 'Jack Villa', 'Joongle', 'Saxena',
            'veranda life', 'Piple', 'DOSA', 'sad app', 'five fi', 'dokha'
        )
    GROUP BY 
        song_name, artist
),

DailyTrackCounts AS (
    SELECT
        song_name,
        artist,
        DATE(created_at) AS created_at,
        play_count,
        COUNT(*) as frequency
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        artist NOT ILIKE '%Revelries%' AND 
        artist NOT ILIKE '%Lone Tusker%' AND 
        artist NOT ILIKE '%Offmind%' AND 
        artist NOT ILIKE '%Jack Villa%' AND 
        artist NOT ILIKE '%Joongle%' AND 
        artist NOT ILIKE '%Saxena%' AND 
        artist NOT ILIKE '%veranda life%' AND 
        artist NOT ILIKE '%Piple%' AND 
        artist NOT ILIKE '%DOSA%' AND 
        artist NOT ILIKE '%sad app%' AND 
        artist NOT ILIKE '%five fi%' AND 
        artist NOT ILIKE '%dokha%'
    GROUP BY
        song_name, artist, DATE(created_at), play_count
),

ModePlayCountPerDay AS (
    SELECT
        song_name,
        artist,
        created_at,
        play_count AS mode_play_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            song_name,
            artist,
            created_at,
            play_count,
            frequency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY song_name, artist, created_at ORDER BY frequency DESC, play_count DESC) as rnum
        FROM
            DailyTrackCounts
    ) AS sq
    WHERE
        rnum = 1
),

daily_change_per_song AS (
    SELECT
        song_name,
        artist,
        created_at,
        mode_play_count - LAG(mode_play_count, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY song_name, artist ORDER BY created_at) AS daily_streams_change,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY song_name, artist ORDER BY created_at DESC) as rnum
    FROM
        ModePlayCountPerDay
)

SELECT 
    d.song_name,
    d.artist,
    l.latest_play_count AS total_streams,
    d.daily_streams_change AS daily_streams
FROM 
    daily_change_per_song d
JOIN
    LatestPlayCounts l ON d.song_name = l.song_name AND d.artist = l.artist
WHERE
    d.created_at > (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM daily_change_per_song) AND
    l.latest_play_count BETWEEN 200000 AND 1000000 AND
    d.daily_streams_change BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 AND
    d.rnum = 1
ORDER BY
    total_streams DESC;

nondeterminism.reason: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (... ORDER BY created_at DESC) keeps one of several rows with an identical created_at (duplicate/colliding track rows)
tiebreak: ORDER BY created_at DESC, play_count DESC

quirks: Daily change = difference to the previous ROW (LAG), not the previous calendar day: a multi-day collection gap is attributed to a single day.
First observation of a track (or a track whose previous calendar day is missing) gets daily change = its whole cumulative count (default 0 for the missing previous day).
Tracks are matched by song_name/artist text, not Spotify id: several Spotify ids (re-releases, linked ids) with the same name are summed or merged.

WITH DailyTrackCounts AS (
    -- Count occurrences of each play_count per day
    SELECT
        DATE(created_at) AS created_at,
        artist,
        CASE 
            WHEN song_name = 'Never Giving Up' OR song_name = 'Never Giving Up Again' THEN 'Never Giving Up Again' 
            ELSE song_name 
        END AS unified_song_name,
        play_count,
        COUNT(*) AS frequency
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE

targets.original_sql:
WITH DailyTrackCounts AS (
    -- Count how many times each play_count occurs per song per day where the selected artist is one of the artists
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN song_name = 'Never Giving Up' OR song_name = 'Never Giving Up Again' THEN 'Never Giving Up/Again' 
            ELSE song_name 
        END AS song_name,
        DATE(created_at) AS created_at,
        play_count,
        COUNT(*) as frequency
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        artist ILIKE '%' || '${artist_name}' || '%'
    GROUP BY
        CASE 
            WHEN song_name = 'Never Giving Up' OR song_name = 'Never Giving Up Again' THEN 'Never Giving Up/Again' 
            ELSE song_name 
        END, DATE(created_at), play_count
),

ModePlayCountPerDay AS (
    -- Find the play_count with the highest frequency per song per day (mode)
    SELECT
        song_name,
        created_at,
        play_count AS mode_play_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            song_name,
            created_at,
            play_count,
            frequency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY song_name, created_at ORDER BY frequency DESC, play_count DESC) as rnum
        FROM
            DailyTrackCounts
    ) AS sq
    WHERE
        rnum = 1
),

daily_change_per_song AS (
    SELECT
        song_name,
        created_at,
        mode_play_count - LAG(mode_play_count, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY song_name ORDER BY created_at) AS daily_streams_change
    FROM
        ModePlayCountPerDay
),

AggregatedDailyChange AS (
    -- Sum up the daily changes for all songs
    SELECT
        created_at AS date,
        SUM(daily_streams_change) AS daily_change_in_streams
    FROM
        daily_change_per_song
    WHERE
        created_at > (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM daily_change_per_song)
    GROUP BY
        created_at
)

SELECT
    date,
    daily_change_in_streams,
    AVG(daily_change_in_streams) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7_days
FROM
    AggregatedDailyChange
ORDER BY
    date;

panels.title: User Guide

options.content:
#### *Set Time Range:*
- See the top right of the dashboard.
- Changing the time range will update all the panels which are graphs. **Panels which are tables don't change**.
- The date and time shown in the time range is the local browser time (UAE), not the VPS/database time (UTC). Whenever you see a date/time in a table (not a graph), that's actually the database time (UTC). For example: the Milestones tables have a *CREATED AT* column which shows the database time. 

#### *Download data to CSV/Excel:*
- Click on the panel options (3 dots on the top right) > Inspect > Data.

#### *Streaming date:*
- The dates (everywhere in Grafana) are the date of data collection, not the date of streaming. To get the actual streaming date, **subtract by 2 days**.
So 30/08/2023 shows the streams for 28/08/2023.

#### *Troubleshooting / Bad time to check:*
- Data for the new day is collected at night for a few hours (somewhere between **10pm to 2am** UAE time). During this time, it's likely that some data is wrong. 
- This is because the script doesn't pick up Spotify's new stream counts for all tracks (only some), or because the script has only run about 2 or 3 times since Spotify updated, so not sure which script reading is correct.
- To check this, you can **open the "Hourly View"** section, and see if there are at least 2 or 3 readings which have the same reading. Do this for each of the 4 playlists (Releases, Extended, GB Releases, GHR Releases).
- Note: The script on the VPS runs once an hour (4:30. 5:30, etc.).

#### *Known issues:*
1. Rarely, it may seem like the reading for a day is complete and consistent, but right towards the end of the day, there are a few more plays which are detected in only a few readings (this could also be Spotify's fault, not sure). Since the graphs take the most-frequently-occurring reading as the correct reading for a particular day, the wrong reading is chosen. For some reason, this doesn't seem to affect the Artist Specific or Track Specific section though. 

2. When artists change their artist name, the database will then have another artist name (which is actually supposed to be the same artist). So be aware of filtering (by artist name) or counting (no. of artists, no. of tracks). Example: "Dozer - Bottle In The Mix" will be seen a separate track from "Aaron Echo - Bottle In The Mix". 
This is taken into account (to some extent) in the "Tracks per Milestones" panel, but in the future, more artists might change names, so should be aware.

#### *Annotations / Corrections:* 
- If the value on any day is wrong, I'll manually add an annotation (vertical dashed blue line) to any/all of the graphs with the correct value written in the note.

WITH HourlyCounts AS (
  SELECT
    playlist_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS hour,
    SUM(play_count) AS hourly_count
  FROM tracks
  WHERE playlist_id = ANY(string_to_array('${person}', ';'))
  GROUP BY playlist_id, hour
),
Frequencies AS (
  SELECT
    playlist_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('day', hour) AS day,
    hourly_count,
    COUNT(*) AS freq
  FROM HourlyCounts
  GROUP BY playlist_id, day, hourly_count
),
MaxFreq AS (
  SELECT
    playlist_id,
    day,
    MAX(freq) AS max_freq
  FROM Frequencies
  GROUP BY playlist_id, day
),
DailyCounts AS (
  SELECT
    f.playlist_id AS metric,
    f.day AS time,
    f.hourly_count AS value
  FROM Frequencies f
  JOIN MaxFreq m 
    ON f.playlist_id = m.playlist_id 
   AND f.day = m.day 
   AND f.freq = m.max_freq
),
Summed AS (
  SELECT
    'Total' AS metric,
    time,
    SUM(value) AS value
  FROM DailyCounts
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT metric, time, value FROM DailyCounts
UNION ALL
SELECT metric, time, value FROM Summed
ORDER BY time, metric;

targets.original_sql:
WITH HourlyTotalCounts AS (
  -- Step 1: Get total play count for each hour across selected playlists
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS hour,
    SUM(play_count) AS hourly_total_count
  FROM
    tracks
  WHERE
    playlist_id = ANY(string_to_array('${person}', ';'))
  GROUP BY
    hour
),
Frequencies AS (
  -- Step 2: Get the most frequent hourly total count for each day
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', hour) AS day,
    hourly_total_count,
    COUNT(*) AS freq
  FROM
    HourlyTotalCounts
  GROUP BY
    day, hourly_total_count
),
MaxFreq AS (
  -- Step 3: Find the most frequently occurring play count per day
  SELECT
    day,
    MAX(freq) AS max_freq
  FROM
    Frequencies
  GROUP BY
    day
),
DailyCumulative AS (
  -- Step 4: Get the final cumulative total stream count for each day
  SELECT
    f.day AS day,
    f.hourly_total_count AS total_stream_count
  FROM
    Frequencies f
  JOIN
    MaxFreq m ON f.day = m.day AND f.freq = m.max_freq
),
DailyGrowth AS (
  -- Step 5: Calculate daily growth by subtracting the previous day's cumulative count
  SELECT
    day,
    total_stream_count - LAG(total_stream_count) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS daily_growth
  FROM
    DailyCumulative
)
-- Final result with revenue calculation and moving averages
SELECT
  day AS "time",
  COALESCE(daily_growth, 0) AS "daily_stream_growth",
  COALESCE(daily_growth * 0.002, 0) AS "revenue",
  ROUND(
      AVG(daily_growth) OVER (
          ORDER BY day 
          ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ),
      2
  ) AS "7_day_moving_avg_streams",
  ROUND(
      AVG(daily_growth * 0.002) OVER (
          ORDER BY day 
          ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ),
      2
  ) AS "7_day_moving_avg_revenue"
FROM
  DailyGrowth
ORDER BY
  day;

    SELECT

        spotify_track_id,
        play_count,
        COUNT(*) AS freq
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        playlist_id = '${playlist_id}'
    GROUP BY
        day, spotify_track_id, play_count
),
ModePlayCountPerDay AS (
    -- Step 2: Find the most frequently occurring play count per track per day
    SELECT
        day,
        spotify_track_id,
        play_count AS mode_play_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            day,
            spotify_track_id,
            play_count,
            freq,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY day, spotify_track_id ORDER BY freq DESC, play_count DESC) AS rnk
        FROM
            DailyTrackCounts
    ) ranked
    WHERE rnk = 1
),
DailyPlaylistTotal AS (
    -- Step 3: Sum the mode play counts for all tracks per day to get accurate daily total
    SELECT
        day,
        SUM(mode_play_count) AS daily_total_streams
    FROM
        ModePlayCountPerDay
    GROUP BY
        day
),
MonthlyStartCounts AS (
    -- Step 4: Get the 2nd day's stream count for each month (for previous months)
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (DATE_TRUNC('month', day))
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day) AS month_start,
        daily_total_streams AS second_day_streams
    FROM
        DailyPlaylistTotal
    WHERE 
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM day) = 2
    ORDER BY
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day), day
),
CurrentMonthGrowth AS (
    -- Step 5: Handle the current month by taking the latest available day instead of waiting
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day) AS month_start,
        MAX(daily_total_streams) AS latest_total_streams
    FROM 
        DailyPlaylistTotal
    WHERE 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    GROUP BY 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day)
),
MonthlyGrowth AS (
    -- Step 6: Calculate the difference for previous months and the current month dynamically
    SELECT
        m.month_start,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.month_start = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) 
            THEN c.latest_total_streams - m.second_day_streams
            ELSE 
                LEAD(m.second_day_streams) OVER (ORDER BY m.month_start) - m.second_day_streams
        END AS monthly_streams
    FROM 
        MonthlyStartCounts m
    LEFT JOIN 
        CurrentMonthGrowth c ON m.month_start = c.month_start
)
-- Final Query for Grafana Table

    TO_CHAR(mg.month_start, '"In "Mon YYYY') AS period,
    COALESCE(mg.monthly_streams, 0) AS "Streams",
    COALESCE(mg.monthly_streams * 0.002, 0) AS "Est. Revenue"
FROM 
    MonthlyGrowth mg
ORDER BY 
    mg.month_start;

                ORDER BY frequency DESC, play_count DESC
            ) AS rnum
        FROM

    ) AS ranked
    WHERE rnum = 1
),

TrackGrowth AS (
    SELECT
        artist,
        song_name,
        day,
        mode_play_count,
        mode_play_count - LAG(mode_play_count) OVER (
            PARTITION BY artist, song_name 
            ORDER BY day
        ) AS daily_growth
    FROM
        ModePlayCountPerDay
),

EarliestAppearances AS (
    SELECT
        artist,
        song_name,
        MIN(DATE(created_at)) AS date_added
    FROM tracks
    WHERE playlist_id = '${playlist_id}'
    GROUP BY artist, song_name
),

LatestTracks AS (
    SELECT
        artist,
        song_name,
        mode_play_count AS latest_play_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY artist, song_name 
            ORDER BY day DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM
        TrackGrowth
),

GrowthCalculation AS (
    SELECT
        t.artist,
        t.song_name,
        t.latest_play_count,
        t.latest_play_count - p.mode_play_count AS growth_24_hours,
        (t.latest_play_count - w.mode_play_count) / 7.0 AS avg_daily_growth,
        e.date_added
    FROM 
        LatestTracks t
    LEFT JOIN TrackGrowth p 
        ON t.artist = p.artist 
        AND t.song_name = p.song_name 
        AND p.day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM TrackGrowth) - INTERVAL '1 day'

        ON t.artist = w.artist 
        AND t.song_name = w.song_name 
        AND w.day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM TrackGrowth) - INTERVAL '7 days'

    WHERE

    FROM
        DailyNewTracks

WITH ExcludedTracks AS (
    -- Manually exclude specific tracks that shouldn't appear in the removed tracks list
    SELECT * FROM (
        VALUES 
            ('BTRN, Chloe, Hugo Ackermann, Saxena, Jordan Grace', 'Floating Away'), --GB RouteNote (alias change)
            ('DAV5, Harry Grant, KORA, DiskWalker', 'Getaway (DiskWalker Remix)'), --GB RouteNote (title change)
            ('Fabian Hernandez DFH, Dress Go, Mathieu Ruz', 'Que Llore'), --GB RouteNote (alias change)
            ('Ugg''A', 'Laisse-moi t''aimere') -- GHR Amuse (title change)
    ) AS t(artist, song_name)
),

AllTracks AS (
    -- Get all unique tracks that ever appeared in the selected playlist
    SELECT DISTINCT artist, song_name
    FROM tracks
    WHERE playlist_id = '${playlist_id}'
),

LatestTracks AS (
    -- Get the latest available track list for the selected playlist
    SELECT DISTINCT artist, song_name
    FROM tracks
    WHERE playlist_id = '${playlist_id}'
    AND created_at = (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM tracks WHERE playlist_id = '${playlist_id}')
),

LastSeen AS (
    -- Get the last known date and time a track was recorded before disappearing
    SELECT 
        artist,
        song_name,
        TO_CHAR(MAX(DATE(created_at)), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS last_seen_date,  -- Ensure only the date is shown
        TO_CHAR(MAX(created_at), 'HH24:MI') AS last_seen_time
    FROM tracks
    WHERE playlist_id = '${playlist_id}'
    GROUP BY artist, song_name
)

SELECT 
    a.artist,
    a.song_name,
    ls.last_seen_date AS "Date Removed",  -- Now only shows YYYY-MM-DD
    ls.last_seen_time AS "Time Removed"
FROM 
    AllTracks a
LEFT JOIN 
    LatestTracks l 
ON 
    a.artist = l.artist AND a.song_name = l.song_name
LEFT JOIN 
    ExcludedTracks e 
ON 
    a.artist = e.artist AND a.song_name = e.song_name
LEFT JOIN 
    LastSeen ls 
ON 
    a.artist = ls.artist AND a.song_name = ls.song_name
WHERE 
    l.artist IS NULL  -- Track existed before but is missing now
    AND e.artist IS NULL  -- Ensure it is NOT in the exclusion list
ORDER BY 
    ls.last_seen_date DESC, ls.last_seen_time DESC;

panels.title: Top Artists | $person: $month

targets.original_sql:
-- TOP ARTISTS • Monthly Stream Growth + Estimated Revenue  (split collabs)
-- Uses dashboard variables:
--   ${person:raw}  – playlist groups / IDs (may include labels & semicolons)
--   ${month:csv}   – YYYY-MM-01 list

WITH vars AS (
    /* 1. MONTHS → DATE[] -------------------------------------------------- */
    SELECT
      ARRAY(
        SELECT TO_DATE(trim(both '''' FROM m), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
        FROM   unnest(string_to_array('${month:csv}', ',')) AS m
      ) AS sel_months,

    /* 2. PLAYLISTS → TEXT[] ---------------------------------------------- */
      ARRAY(
        SELECT trim(p_id)
        FROM (
          SELECT unnest(string_to_array('${person:raw}', ',')) AS chunk
        ) cs
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT unnest(string_to_array(chunk, ';')) AS raw_piece
        ) ss
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT regexp_replace(raw_piece, '^[^:]*:\\s*', '') AS p_id
        ) cleaned
        WHERE p_id <> ''
      ) AS sel_playlists
),

/* ① mode of the day per track ------------------------------------------- */
daily_track_counts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(t.created_at) AS day,
        t.spotify_track_id,
        t.song_name,
        t.artist,
        t.play_count,
        COUNT(*) AS freq
    FROM tracks t
    CROSS JOIN vars v
    WHERE t.playlist_id = ANY (v.sel_playlists)
    GROUP BY day, t.spotify_track_id, t.song_name, t.artist, t.play_count
),

mode_playcount_per_day AS (
    SELECT
        day, spotify_track_id, song_name, artist,
        play_count AS mode_play_count
    FROM (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY day, spotify_track_id
                   ORDER BY freq DESC, play_count DESC
               ) AS rnk
        FROM daily_track_counts
    ) ranked
    WHERE rnk = 1
),

/* ② snapshot on 2nd day of month ---------------------------------------- */
track_monthly_start AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (spotify_track_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', day))
        spotify_track_id, song_name, artist,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day) AS month_start,
        mode_play_count          AS second_day_playcount
    FROM mode_playcount_per_day
    WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM day) = 2
    ORDER BY spotify_track_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', day), day
),

/* ③ latest total for current month -------------------------------------- */
current_month_latest AS (
    SELECT
        mpd.spotify_track_id, mpd.song_name, mpd.artist,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AS month_start,
        MAX(mpd.mode_play_count) AS latest_total
    FROM mode_playcount_per_day mpd
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', mpd.day) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    GROUP BY mpd.spotify_track_id, mpd.song_name, mpd.artist
),

/* ④ growth per track per month ------------------------------------------ */
track_monthly_growth AS (
    SELECT
        t1.spotify_track_id, t1.song_name, t1.artist, t1.month_start,
        CASE
            WHEN t1.month_start = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
            THEN c.latest_total - t1.second_day_playcount
            ELSE LEAD(t1.second_day_playcount)
                   OVER (PARTITION BY t1.spotify_track_id
                         ORDER BY t1.month_start)
                 - t1.second_day_playcount
        END AS monthly_streams
    FROM track_monthly_start t1
    LEFT JOIN current_month_latest c
         ON c.spotify_track_id = t1.spotify_track_id
        AND c.month_start      = t1.month_start
),

/* ⑤ explode artist list so each name gets full credit ------------------- */
artist_split AS (
    SELECT
        trim(both ' ' FROM unnest(string_to_array(tg.artist, ','))) AS solo_artist,
        tg.monthly_streams
    FROM   track_monthly_growth tg
    JOIN   vars v ON tg.month_start = ANY (v.sel_months)
    WHERE  tg.monthly_streams IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT (tg.artist = 'Lelo, Öldskool'           AND tg.song_name = 'Better Days')
      AND NOT (tg.artist = 'Nøway'                   AND tg.song_name = 'Cursed')
      AND NOT (tg.artist = 'JMRA, Scarlett, Jr Stit' AND tg.song_name = 'So Long Ago - Remix')
)

/* ⑥ final aggregation ---------------------------------------------------- */
SELECT
    solo_artist                         AS "Artist",
    SUM(monthly_streams)                AS "Streams",
    SUM(monthly_streams) * 0.002        AS "Est. Revenue"
FROM   artist_split
GROUP  BY solo_artist
ORDER  BY "Streams" DESC
LIMIT  100;

                         order by t1.month_start)
                 - t1.second_day_playcount
        end as monthly_streams
    from track_monthly_start t1
    left join current_month_latest c
      on c.spotify_track_id = t1.spotify_track_id
     and c.month_start      = t1.month_start
)

/* 5️⃣  final result --------------------------------------------------------- */
select
    tg.artist || ' - ' || tg.song_name           as "Artist - Track",
    sum(tg.monthly_streams)                      as "Streams",
    sum(tg.monthly_streams) * 0.002              as "Est. Revenue"
from   track_monthly_growth tg
join   vars v on tg.month_start = any (v.sel_months)   -- keep only selected months
where  tg.monthly_streams is not null
  and not (tg.artist = 'Lelo, Öldskool'           and tg.song_name = 'Better Days')
  and not (tg.artist = 'Nøway'                   and tg.song_name = 'Cursed')
  and not (tg.artist = 'JMRA, Scarlett, Jr Stit' and tg.song_name = 'So Long Ago - Remix')
group  by "Artist - Track"
order  by "Streams" desc
limit  100;

WITH HourlyTotalCounts AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS hour,
    SUM(play_count) AS hourly_total_count
  FROM
    tracks
  WHERE
    playlist_id = ANY(string_to_array('${person}', ';'))
  GROUP BY
    hour
),
Frequencies AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', hour) AS day,
    hourly_total_count,
    COUNT(*) AS freq
  FROM
    HourlyTotalCounts
  GROUP BY
    day, hourly_total_count
),
MaxFreq AS (
  SELECT
    day,
    MAX(freq) AS max_freq
  FROM
    Frequencies
  GROUP BY
    day
)
SELECT
  f.day AS "time",
  f.hourly_total_count AS "total_stream_count"
FROM
  Frequencies f
JOIN
  MaxFreq m ON f.day = m.day AND f.freq = m.max_freq
ORDER BY
  "time";

),
Frequencies AS (
  -- Calculate frequency of each hourly total play count for each day
  SELECT

),

WITH FirstAddedDates AS (
    -- Get the earliest date each unique track was added to the playlist
    SELECT
        song_name || ' - ' || artist AS track_id,
        MIN(DATE(created_at)) AS first_added_date
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        playlist_id = '5D5udmssxsBVOTuLNddeoD'
    GROUP BY
        song_name || ' - ' || artist
),
DailyNewTracks AS (
    -- Count the number of new tracks added on each date
    SELECT
        first_added_date AS day,
        COUNT(*) AS new_tracks
    FROM
        FirstAddedDates
    GROUP BY
        first_added_date
),
CumulativeTracks AS (
    -- Calculate the cumulative number of tracks up to each date
    SELECT
        day,
        SUM(new_tracks) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_track_count
    FROM
        DailyNewTracks
)
SELECT
    day,
    cumulative_track_count
FROM
    CumulativeTracks
ORDER BY
    day;

WITH HourlyTotalCounts AS (
  -- Calculate the total play_count for the entire playlist for each hour
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS hour,
    SUM(play_count) AS hourly_total_count
  FROM
    tracks
  WHERE
    playlist_id IN ('5xF12DikWaPSwjvwwVWUbe')
  GROUP BY
    hour
),
Frequencies AS (
  -- Calculate frequency of each hourly total play count for each day
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', hour) AS day,
    hourly_total_count,
    COUNT(*) AS freq
  FROM
    HourlyTotalCounts
  GROUP BY
    day, hourly_total_count
),
MaxFreq AS (
  -- For each day, find the max frequency for hourly total play count
  SELECT
    day,
    MAX(freq) AS max_freq
  FROM
    Frequencies
  GROUP BY
    day
)
-- Manually corrected values
, Corrections AS (
  SELECT
    '2023-08-10'::date AS "time",
    470767881 AS "total_stream_count"
  --example of adding another correction:
  --UNION ALL
  --SELECT
    --'2023-08-11'::date AS "time",
    --500000000 AS "total_stream_count"
)
-- Final Query
SELECT
  CASE 
    WHEN f.day = '2023-08-10'::date THEN c."time"
    --example of adding another correction:
    --WHEN f.day = '2023-08-11'::date THEN c."time"
    ELSE f.day
  END AS "time",
  CASE 
    WHEN f.day = '2023-08-10'::date THEN c."total_stream_count"
    --example of adding another correction:
    --WHEN f.day = '2023-08-11'::date THEN c."total_stream_count"
    ELSE f.hourly_total_count
  END AS "total_stream_count"
FROM
  Frequencies f
JOIN
  MaxFreq m ON f.day = m.day AND f.freq = m.max_freq
LEFT JOIN
  Corrections c ON f.day = c."time"
ORDER BY
  "time";

WITH HourlyTotalCounts AS (
  -- Calculate the total play_count for the entire playlist for each hour
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS hour,
    SUM(play_count) AS hourly_total_count
  FROM
    tracks
  WHERE
    playlist_id IN ('6gawSv5LS8it1FtRvfVbDb')
  GROUP BY
    hour
),
Frequencies AS (
  -- Calculate frequency of each hourly total play count for each day
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', hour) AS day,
    hourly_total_count,
    COUNT(*) AS freq
  FROM
    HourlyTotalCounts
  GROUP BY
    day, hourly_total_count
),
MaxFreq AS (
  -- For each day, find the max frequency for hourly total play count
  SELECT
    day,
    MAX(freq) AS max_freq
  FROM
    Frequencies
  GROUP BY
    day
)
-- Manually corrected values
, Corrections AS (
  SELECT
    '2023-08-10'::date AS "time",
    470767881 AS "total_stream_count"
  --example of adding another correction:
  --UNION ALL
  --SELECT
    --'2023-08-11'::date AS "time",
    --500000000 AS "total_stream_count"
)
-- Final Query
SELECT
  CASE 
    WHEN f.day = '2023-08-10'::date THEN c."time"
    --example of adding another correction:
    --WHEN f.day = '2023-08-11'::date THEN c."time"
    ELSE f.day
  END AS "time",
  CASE 
    WHEN f.day = '2023-08-10'::date THEN c."total_stream_count"
    --example of adding another correction:
    --WHEN f.day = '2023-08-11'::date THEN c."total_stream_count"
    ELSE f.hourly_total_count
  END AS "total_stream_count"
FROM
  Frequencies f
JOIN
  MaxFreq m ON f.day = m.day AND f.freq = m.max_freq
LEFT JOIN
  Corrections c ON f.day = c."time"
ORDER BY
  "time";

WITH FirstAddedDates AS (
    -- Get the earliest date each unique track was added to the playlist
    SELECT
        song_name || ' - ' || artist AS track_id,
        MIN(DATE(created_at)) AS first_added_date
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        playlist_id = '6S9RD0jNqWh2CEvM32JOgY'
    GROUP BY
        song_name || ' - ' || artist
),
DailyNewTracks AS (
    -- Count the number of new tracks added on each date
    SELECT
        first_added_date AS day,
        COUNT(*) AS new_tracks
    FROM
        FirstAddedDates
    GROUP BY
        first_added_date
),
CumulativeTracks AS (
    -- Calculate the cumulative number of tracks up to each date
    SELECT
        day,
        SUM(new_tracks) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_track_count
    FROM
        DailyNewTracks
)
SELECT
    day,
    cumulative_track_count
FROM
    CumulativeTracks
ORDER BY
    day;

WITH HourlyTotalCounts AS (
    -- Calculate the total play_count for the playlist for each hour
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS hour,
        SUM(play_count) AS hourly_total_count
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        playlist_id = '6S9RD0jNqWh2CEvM32JOgY'
    GROUP BY
        hour
),
Frequencies AS (
    -- Calculate frequency of each hourly total play count for each day
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', hour) AS day,
        hourly_total_count,
        COUNT(*) AS freq
    FROM
        HourlyTotalCounts
    GROUP BY
        day, hourly_total_count
),
MaxFreq AS (
    -- For each day, find the max frequency for hourly total play count
    SELECT
        day,
        CASE
            WHEN day = '2023-08-10' THEN 470767881
            ELSE hourly_total_count
        END AS mode_hourly_total_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            day,
            hourly_total_count,
            freq,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY day ORDER BY freq DESC, hourly_total_count DESC) as rnum
        FROM
            Frequencies
    ) AS sq
    WHERE
        rnum = 1
),
cumulative_totals AS (
    SELECT
        day,
        mode_hourly_total_count,
        LAG(mode_hourly_total_count, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS prev_day_total_count
    FROM
        MaxFreq
)

    day AS "time",
    (mode_hourly_total_count - prev_day_total_count) AS "daily_change_in_streams"
FROM
    cumulative_totals
WHERE
    day > (SELECT MIN(day) FROM cumulative_totals)

    "time";

panels.title: Total Streams vs Daily Streams
panels.description: Tracks plotted by Total Streams vs Daily Streams (as of latest data)

targets.original_sql:
WITH 
DailyTrackCounts AS (
    -- Count how many times each play_count occurs for the track per day
    SELECT
        DATE(created_at) AS created_at,
        song_name,
        artist,
        play_count,
        COUNT(*) as frequency
    FROM
        tracks
    GROUP BY
        DATE(created_at), song_name, artist, play_count
),

ModePlayCountPerDay AS (
    -- Find the play_count with the highest frequency for the track per day (mode)
    SELECT
        created_at,
        song_name,
        artist,
        play_count AS mode_play_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            created_at,
            song_name,
            artist,
            play_count,
            frequency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY created_at, song_name, artist ORDER BY frequency DESC, play_count DESC) as rnum
        FROM
            DailyTrackCounts
    ) AS sq
    WHERE
        rnum = 1
),

daily_change AS (
    SELECT
        t1.song_name,
        t1.artist,
        t1.created_at AS date,
        t1.mode_play_count - COALESCE(t2.mode_play_count, 0) AS daily_streams_change
    FROM
        ModePlayCountPerDay t1
    LEFT JOIN
        ModePlayCountPerDay t2
    ON
        t1.song_name = t2.song_name
        AND t1.artist = t2.artist
        AND t1.created_at = t2.created_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
),

latest_tracks AS (
    SELECT 
        song_name, 
        artist, 
        MAX(play_count) AS max_play_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            song_name, 
            artist, 
            play_count, 
            RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY song_name, artist ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rnk
        FROM tracks 
        WHERE date(created_at) = current_date
    ) AS ranked_tracks
    WHERE rnk = 1
    GROUP BY song_name, artist
)

SELECT 
    lt.artist || ' - ' || lt.song_name AS "Artist - Track", 
    lt.max_play_count AS "Total Streams",
    dc.daily_streams_change AS "Daily Streams"
FROM latest_tracks lt
JOIN daily_change dc ON lt.song_name = dc.song_name AND lt.artist = dc.artist
WHERE
  dc.date = current_date
ORDER BY "Total Streams" DESC, "Daily Streams" DESC
LIMIT 100;

targets.original_sql:
SELECT milestone, COUNT(DISTINCT song_name) AS unique_tracks
FROM (
  SELECT song_name,
         milestone, 
         CASE 
           WHEN RIGHT(milestone, 1) = 'K' THEN CAST(REPLACE(milestone, 'K', '') AS FLOAT)
           WHEN RIGHT(milestone, 1) = 'M' THEN CAST(REPLACE(milestone, 'M', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000
           WHEN RIGHT(milestone, 1) = 'B' THEN CAST(REPLACE(milestone, 'B', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000000
         END as sorting_col
  FROM milestones
) sub_query
GROUP BY milestone, sorting_col
ORDER BY sorting_col DESC;

           when right(milestone, 1) = 'M' then cast(replace(milestone, 'M', '') as double) * 1000

            ('DOSA, Joongle, Piple', 'Killing Me Softly With His Song'), --GB RouteNote (alias change)
            ('DOSA, Joongle', 'Can''t Feel My Face'), --GB RouteNote (alias change)
            ('Joongle', 'La Vie En Rose'), --GB RouteNote (alias change)
            ('Joongle', 'Outta My Head') --GB RouteNote (alias change)
            
    ) AS t(artist, song_name)
),

AllTracks AS (
    -- Get all unique tracks that ever appeared in the selected playlist
    SELECT DISTINCT artist, song_name
    FROM tracks
    WHERE playlist_id = '${playlist_id}'
),

LatestTracks AS (
    -- Get the latest available track list for the selected playlist
    SELECT DISTINCT artist, song_name
    FROM tracks
    WHERE playlist_id = '${playlist_id}'
    AND created_at = (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM tracks WHERE playlist_id = '${playlist_id}')
),

LastSeen AS (
    -- Get the last known date and time a track was recorded before disappearing
    SELECT 
        artist,
        song_name,
        TO_CHAR(MAX(DATE(created_at)), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS last_seen_date,  -- Ensure only the date is shown
        TO_CHAR(MAX(created_at), 'HH24:MI') AS last_seen_time
    FROM tracks
    WHERE playlist_id = '${playlist_id}'
    GROUP BY artist, song_name
)

SELECT 
    a.artist,
    a.song_name,
    ls.last_seen_date AS "Date Removed",  -- Now only shows YYYY-MM-DD
    ls.last_seen_time AS "Time Removed"
FROM 
    AllTracks a
LEFT JOIN 
    LatestTracks l 
ON 
    a.artist = l.artist AND a.song_name = l.song_name
LEFT JOIN 
    ExcludedTracks e 
ON 
    a.artist = e.artist AND a.song_name = e.song_name
LEFT JOIN 
    LastSeen ls 
ON 
    a.artist = ls.artist AND a.song_name = ls.song_name
WHERE 
    l.artist IS NULL  -- Track existed before but is missing now
    AND e.artist IS NULL  -- Ensure it is NOT in the exclusion list
ORDER BY 
    ls.last_seen_date DESC, ls.last_seen_time DESC;

WITH DailyTrackCounts AS (
    -- Step 1: Get daily total streams per track
    SELECT
        DATE(created_at) AS day,
        spotify_track_id,
        play_count,
        COUNT(*) AS freq
    FROM
        tracks
    WHERE
        playlist_id = '0BvmJ4q8BHeXxCtnkTbXiC'
    GROUP BY
        day, spotify_track_id, play_count
),
ModePlayCountPerDay AS (
    -- Step 2: Find the most frequently occurring play count per track per day
    SELECT
        day,
        spotify_track_id,
        play_count AS mode_play_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            day,
            spotify_track_id,
            play_count,
            freq,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY day, spotify_track_id ORDER BY freq DESC, play_count DESC) AS rnk
        FROM
            DailyTrackCounts
    ) ranked
    WHERE rnk = 1
),
DailyPlaylistTotal AS (
    -- Step 3: Sum the mode play counts for all tracks per day to get accurate daily total
    SELECT
        day,
        SUM(mode_play_count) AS daily_total_streams
    FROM
        ModePlayCountPerDay
    GROUP BY
        day
),
MonthlyStartCounts AS (
    -- Step 4: Get the 2nd day's stream count for each month (for previous months)
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (DATE_TRUNC('month', day))
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day) AS month_start,
        daily_total_streams AS second_day_streams
    FROM
        DailyPlaylistTotal
    WHERE 
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM day) = 2
    ORDER BY
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day), day
),
CurrentMonthGrowth AS (
    -- Step 5: Handle the current month by taking the latest available day instead of waiting
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day) AS month_start,
        MAX(daily_total_streams) AS latest_total_streams
    FROM 
        DailyPlaylistTotal
    WHERE 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    GROUP BY 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', day)
),
MonthlyGrowth AS (
    -- Step 6: Calculate the difference for previous months and the current month dynamically
    SELECT
        m.month_start,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.month_start = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) 
            THEN c.latest_total_streams - m.second_day_streams
            ELSE 
                LEAD(m.second_day_streams) OVER (ORDER BY m.month_start) - m.second_day_streams
        END AS monthly_streams
    FROM 
        MonthlyStartCounts m
    LEFT JOIN 
        CurrentMonthGrowth c ON m.month_start = c.month_start
),
ActualRevenue AS (
    -- Manual Actual Revenue input
    SELECT * FROM (
        VALUES 
            ('In May 2024', 0),
            ('In Jun 2024', NULL),
            ('In Jul 2024', NULL),
            ('In Aug 2024', NULL),
            ('In Sep 2024', NULL),
            ('In Oct 2024', NULL),
            ('In Nov 2024', NULL),
            ('In Dec 2024', NULL),
            ('In Jan 2025', NULL)  -- Placeholder for future data
    ) AS t(period, actual_revenue)
)
-- Final Query for Grafana Table
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(mg.month_start, '"In "Mon YYYY') AS period,
    COALESCE(mg.monthly_streams, 0) AS "Streams",
    COALESCE(mg.monthly_streams * 0.002, 0) AS "Est. Revenue",
    ar.actual_revenue AS "Actual Revenue",
    (COALESCE(mg.monthly_streams * 0.002, 0) - ar.actual_revenue) AS "Difference",
    CASE
        WHEN ar.actual_revenue IS NOT NULL AND ar.actual_revenue <> 0 THEN
            ((COALESCE(mg.monthly_streams * 0.002, 0) - ar.actual_revenue) * 100 / ar.actual_revenue)
        ELSE
            NULL
    END AS "Difference (%)"
FROM 
    MonthlyGrowth mg
LEFT JOIN 
    ActualRevenue ar 
ON 
    TO_CHAR(mg.month_start, '"In "Mon YYYY') = ar.period
ORDER BY 
    mg.month_start;

  date,
  daily_growth,
  AVG(daily_growth) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "7_day_moving_avg"
FROM (
  SELECT
    date,
    COALESCE(total_followers - LAG(total_followers) OVER (ORDER BY date), 0) AS daily_growth
  FROM (
    SELECT
      sub.date AS date,
      SUM(sub.latest_followers) AS total_followers
    FROM (
      SELECT
        playlist_id,
        followers AS latest_followers,
        timestamp::date AS date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY playlist_id, timestamp::date ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS rn
      FROM
        spotify_followers
    ) sub
    WHERE sub.rn = 1
    GROUP BY sub.date
  ) sub_query
) growth_data
ORDER BY date;

panels.title: Fastest Growing Accounts
panels.description:
Followers Per Account. Based on last day's change (today's followers at 6PM minus yesterday's followers at 6PM). 

NOTE: Data updates every day at 6PM.

targets.original_sql:
WITH LatestEntries AS (
  SELECT
    account_name,
    followers,
    timestamp,
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp) AS hour_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_name, playlist_id, DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM spotify_followers
),
TodayCheck AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS count_today
  FROM LatestEntries
  WHERE rn = 1 AND DATE(hour_timestamp) = CURRENT_DATE AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hour_timestamp) = 14
),
TodayEntries AS (
  SELECT
    account_name,
    SUM(followers) AS today_followers
  FROM LatestEntries
  WHERE rn = 1 AND DATE(hour_timestamp) = (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count_today FROM TodayCheck) > 0 THEN CURRENT_DATE ELSE CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' END) AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hour_timestamp) = 14
  GROUP BY account_name
),
YesterdayEntries AS (
  SELECT
    account_name,
    SUM(followers) AS yesterday_followers
  FROM LatestEntries
  WHERE rn = 1 AND DATE(hour_timestamp) = (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count_today FROM TodayCheck) > 0 THEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' ELSE CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 day' END) AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hour_timestamp) = 14
  GROUP BY account_name
)
SELECT
  T.account_name,
  (T.today_followers - COALESCE(Y.yesterday_followers, 0)) AS daily_change
FROM TodayEntries T
LEFT JOIN YesterdayEntries Y ON T.account_name = Y.account_name
ORDER BY daily_change DESC
LIMIT 25;

panels.title: $account - Fastest Growing Playlists
panels.description:
Top 10. Based on last day's change (today's followers at 6PM minus yesterday's followers at 6PM). 

NOTE: Data updates every day at 6PM.

targets.original_sql:
WITH LatestEntries AS (
  SELECT
    playlist_id,
    playlist_name,
    followers,
    timestamp,
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp) AS hour_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY playlist_id, DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM spotify_followers
  WHERE account_name = $account
),
TodayCheck AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS count_today
  FROM LatestEntries
  WHERE rn = 1 AND DATE(hour_timestamp) = CURRENT_DATE AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hour_timestamp) = 14
),
TodayEntries AS (
  SELECT
    playlist_id,
    playlist_name,
    followers AS today_followers,
    hour_timestamp
  FROM LatestEntries
  WHERE rn = 1 AND DATE(hour_timestamp) = (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count_today FROM TodayCheck) > 0 THEN CURRENT_DATE ELSE CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' END) AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hour_timestamp) = 14
),
YesterdayEntries AS (
  SELECT
    playlist_id,
    playlist_name,
    followers AS yesterday_followers,
    hour_timestamp
  FROM LatestEntries
  WHERE rn = 1 AND DATE(hour_timestamp) = (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count_today FROM TodayCheck) > 0 THEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' ELSE CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 days' END) AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hour_timestamp) = 14
)
SELECT
  T.playlist_name,
  T.today_followers,
  Y.yesterday_followers,
  (T.today_followers - Y.yesterday_followers) AS daily_change,
  T.hour_timestamp,
  'https://open.spotify.com/playlist/' || T.playlist_id AS playlist_url
FROM TodayEntries T
JOIN YesterdayEntries Y ON T.playlist_id = Y.playlist_id
ORDER BY daily_change DESC
LIMIT 10;

FROM (
  SELECT
    followers,
    timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

    ) AS rn
  FROM spotify_followers

      ' RELAXING VIBES 🍹🌞🌴'          -- one leading space
    )
) sub

panels.title: Fastest Growing Playlists (w/o London Grams)
panels.description:
Top 50. Based on last day's change (today's followers at 6PM minus yesterday's followers at 6PM). 

NOTE: Data updates every day at 6PM.

targets.original_sql:
WITH LatestEntries AS (
  SELECT
    playlist_id,
    playlist_name,
    account_name,
    followers,
    timestamp,
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp) AS hour_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY playlist_id, DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM spotify_followers
),
TodayCheck AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS count_today
  FROM LatestEntries
  WHERE rn = 1 AND DATE(hour_timestamp) = CURRENT_DATE AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hour_timestamp) = 14
),
TodayEntries AS (
  SELECT
    playlist_id,
    playlist_name,
    account_name,
    followers AS today_followers,
    hour_timestamp
  FROM LatestEntries
  WHERE rn = 1 AND DATE(hour_timestamp) = (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count_today FROM TodayCheck) > 0 THEN CURRENT_DATE ELSE CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' END) 
        AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hour_timestamp) = 14
        AND account_name <> 'London Grams'  -- Exclude 'London Grams'
),
YesterdayEntries AS (
  SELECT
    playlist_id,
    playlist_name,
    account_name,
    followers AS yesterday_followers,
    hour_timestamp
  FROM LatestEntries
  WHERE rn = 1 AND DATE(hour_timestamp) = (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count_today FROM TodayCheck) > 0 THEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' ELSE CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 days' END)
        AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hour_timestamp) = 14
        AND account_name <> 'London Grams'  -- Exclude 'London Grams'
)
SELECT
  T.playlist_name,
  T.account_name,
  T.today_followers,
  Y.yesterday_followers,
  (T.today_followers - Y.yesterday_followers) AS daily_change,
  T.hour_timestamp
FROM TodayEntries T
JOIN YesterdayEntries Y ON T.playlist_id = Y.playlist_id
ORDER BY daily_change DESC
LIMIT 50;
targets.duckdb_sql:
with latestentries as (
  select
    playlist_id,
    playlist_name,
    account_name,
    followers,
    timestamp,
    date_trunc('hour', timestamp) as hour_timestamp,
    row_number() over (partition by playlist_id, date_trunc('hour', timestamp) order by timestamp desc) as rn
  from spotify_followers
),
todaycheck as (
  select
    count(*) as count_today
  from latestentries
  where rn = 1 and date(hour_timestamp) = anchor_date() and extract(hour from hour_timestamp) = 14
),
todayentries as (
  select
    playlist_id,
    playlist_name,
    account_name,
    followers as today_followers,
    hour_timestamp
  from latestentries
  where rn = 1 and date(hour_timestamp) = (select case when (select count_today from todaycheck) > 0 then anchor_date() else anchor_date() - interval '1 day' end) 
        and extract(hour from hour_timestamp) = 14
        and account_name <> 'London Grams'  -- Exclude 'London Grams'
),
yesterdayentries as (
  select
    playlist_id,
    playlist_name,
    account_name,
    followers as yesterday_followers,
    hour_timestamp
  from latestentries
  where rn = 1 and date(hour_timestamp) = (select case when (select count_today from todaycheck) > 0 then anchor_date() - interval '1 day' else anchor_date() - interval '2 days' end)
        and extract(hour from hour_timestamp) = 14
        and account_name <> 'London Grams'  -- Exclude 'London Grams'
)
select
  t.playlist_name,
  t.account_name,
  t.today_followers,
  y.yesterday_followers,
  (t.today_followers - y.yesterday_followers) as daily_change,
  t.hour_timestamp
from todayentries t
join yesterdayentries y on t.playlist_id = y.playlist_id
order by daily_change desc
limit 50;

quirks: Uses only the reading of the 14:00 UTC hour of today/yesterday; falls back one day when today has no 14:00 reading.
